constraints: NS2 compatibility is title- and build-specific; an upstream claim is not NXBridge validation.
The host API header is a draft, so integration must use verified concrete hooks.
Game assets, keys, saves, generated game modules and shaders stay outside version control.
Existing nxnative BOTW and TOTK deployments remain separate from this experiment.
OoT gameplay, checkpoint reload and Pad touch streaming passed bounded smoke tests; sustained FPS, game speed, audio sync and multiplayer capacity remain unvalidated.
The public launcher uses per-session shader caches; the warm-cache Pad run used a private single-build seeding experiment.
